nodes.title: The round's hand-kept list of 336 test files passed with 0 failing while the whole suite (758 files) had one failing: an old fixture script walked through the new code, which reached a path none of the 36 dry lessons reach

After a key with its help spent, when a return to the child's side-topic is due in the same turn, she says the go-on line and then the return; "I can't put this more simply" is never said before a return, on any path
A build round's last agent runs the whole unit suite the gate runs (the leak check's list), not a list of the files the round touched

md.decisions:
- `dc-r8-go-on-line-before-aside-return` (2026-11-23, main; completes to-brain 049 B6's item from 047 R5 and replaces the seam pass's earlier choice for this turn): a child has heard a card's key and its other wording and gives up again; nothing is left to say, and a return to her side-topic is due. The turn is the script's go-on line and the return's question ("Koi baat nahi, chalo aage badhte hain. Waise, cricket mein …?"). The "nothing easier" line is not said before a return on any path: where no key has been said and no go-on line applies, nothing stands in its place. Built in `server/brain/seams.js` (8a8966fb5); `spentThenReturn` is gated and the old fixture `tests/fixtures/scripts-point-card-one-turn` reaches the path. **Why:** a judge heard "I can't say this more simply" followed at once by cricket as the teacher dropping the child (director31, c4-ch01-t02 stuck 68); the seam pass had been keeping that line and dropping the go-on line because an earlier judge heard "abhi aage badhte hain. Ab cricket ki baat karte hain" as a contradiction, when the return was a statement. The return is now a question that opens "Waise,", which a go-on line can precede. **What would reverse it:** a judge hearing the go-on line and the return together as a contradiction again; then each script gets a short consolation form with no "we go on" in it for this turn, and code says that.
- `dc-r8-agents-run-the-whole-suite` (2026-11-23, main): the last agent of a build round runs the same list the gate's leak check runs (every unit suite, two at a time, in batches) before it reports; a list of touched files is for the inner loop only. **Why:** `fd-r8-round-test-list-missed-a-walker`: the miss cost one gate cycle and was found only because the gate is not the agents' list. **What would reverse it:** the whole suite growing past what an agent can run in a session; then the list is generated (every test that imports `server/director`, `server/brain` or the predicates), never kept by hand.
md.measurements: - `fd-r8-round-test-list-missed-a-walker` (2026-11-23, finding): the d33 build agents ran a list of 336 test files (4,176 pass, 0 fail). The gate's leak check (758 suites, 4 processes, seed 20261123) failed one: `tests/r8-main-034.test.mjs`, which walks a pre-round fixture script through today's code. Three causes: the fixture had no `joints.yourTurn` (data; added); `hindiCard` refused the invitation that ends a third turn running at one question (predicate; brought to to-brain 049 B4); and "nothing easier" before an aside's return was still reachable where the return is decided after the walk (code; fixed, `dc-r8-go-on-line-before-aside-return`). The 36 dry lessons did not reach that path: their spoken text is identical before and after the fix.
